description: This file implements a repository access cache for lockdown checks, including cache management, querying GitHub GraphQL API for repository permissions, and determining safe content access based on user roles and repository privacy.

classes.name: RepoAccessCache
classes.description: Caches repository metadata related to lockdown checks, supporting thread-safe access, cache management, and querying GitHub for permissions.

classes.name: RepoAccessInfo
classes.description: Holds repository metadata needed for lockdown decisions, including privacy status, push access, and viewer login.

classes.name: repoAccessCacheEntry
classes.description: Represents a cache entry with privacy status, known users' push access, and viewer login.

classes.name: CacheStats
classes.description: Summarizes cache activity counters such as hits, misses, and evictions.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RepoAccessCache, initializing it if necessary with provided client and options.

methods.name: SetLogger
methods.description: Updates the logger used for cache diagnostics.

methods.name: IsSafeContent
methods.description: Determines if a user can safely access repository content based on permissions, privacy, and trusted bots.

methods.name: getRepoAccessInfo
methods.description: Retrieves repository access info from cache or via API query, updating cache as needed.

methods.name: queryRepoAccessInfo
methods.description: Queries GitHub GraphQL API for detailed repository access information.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages at specified log level if logger is enabled.

methods.name: isTrustedBot
methods.description: Checks if a username is a trusted bot.
